metadata.name: Doom64EX-Ultra
metadata.summary: Enhanced DOOM 64 source port recreating the Nintendo 64 experience with modern engine features and remaster support

content.value: Doom64EX-Ultra is an enhanced source port continuation of Samuel "Kaiser" Villarreal's Doom 64 EX project. Built modernizing around SDL3, OpenGL, and FMOD Studio, it aims to faithfully recreate the classic Nintendo 64 dark atmospheric DOOM experience on modern Linux systems while incorporating significant modding capabilities and performance improvements.

The engine offers full compatibility with the official 2020 Nightdive Studios remaster IWAD, allowing players to experience the base game and "The Lost Levels" expansion with native KPF and PWAD mod support.

items.value: Native support for official 2020 remaster IWADs, KPF packages, and custom PWAD mods
Includes full campaign support for The Lost Levels expansion content
Upgraded audio subsystem powered by FMOD Studio for high-quality audio playback
Custom shaders delivering authentic Nintendo 64 3-point texture filtering
Modernized cross-platform codebase built on SDL3 and OpenGL rendering
Quality-of-life additions including secret discovery notifications and expanded map slot capacity
